newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - M.S. Carriers upgraded.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - M.S. Carriers upgraded.

text.p: Salomon Brothers Inc said on Monday it upgraded its rating on the shares of M.S. Carriers Inc to buy from hold and raised its earnings estimates, after a meeting with the company.

-- Analyst James Valentine said in a research note he was raising his 1997 earnings estimate to $1.45 per share from $1.40 per share and his 1998 earnings estimate to $1.70 per share from $1.65 per share.
-- Valentine said he visited the company last week and came away with a more favorable outlook for M.S. Carriers over the next 12 months.
-- "We are raising our earnings per share esimates this year and next...due to a favorable environment which is allowing the company to add capacity earlier than expected," he said.
